t: The $(5)Block Alter Module$() is an optional module for the $(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)Interdiction Matrix$(). It enables a Matrix to inhibit a player's ability to place or break blocks. If a player tries to break or place a block that falls within the action area of the $(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)Interdiction Matrix$(), it will inform the player that they do not have permission to do this and then reverse whatever they may have done.
$(5)防修改模块$()是$(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)干涉矩阵$()的可选模块。它使干涉矩阵能够限制玩家放置或破坏方块的能力。若玩家试图在$(l:mffs:machines/interdiction_matrix)干涉矩阵$()的作用区域内破坏或放置方块，系统将提示其无权执行该操作，并撤销已进行的任何更改。
